summary: Frontend testing of Suggestions feature (nav item, submit form, coach mine list, admin all-suggestions tab + status dropdown, admin-note propagation). All 4 test scenarios PASSED end-to-end against the preview URL.

test_details.T1_coach_nav_and_page: PASS - Suggestions nav item visible in MEMBER sidebar for coach.test@example.com. Clicking nav lands on /suggestions. suggestions-page, suggestion-form, suggestion-text, suggestion-category, suggestion-submit all visible. suggestion-tabs NOT rendered for non-admin (correct).
test_details.T2_submit_flow: PASS - Short text (<3 chars) shows error toast and does NOT submit. Valid submit: success toast, textarea cleared, new item appears in Your suggestions list with status-new badge (suggestion-status-new).
test_details.T3_admin_all_tab: PASS - admin@attendance.app sees both form and suggestion-tabs. All-suggestions tab lists 2 rows including coach's suggestion with submitter name 'Coach Test User'. Status dropdown (suggestion-status-select-<id>) changed to 'planned' -> success toast, persisted after reload (verified value=planned).
test_details.T4_coach_sees_updated_status: PASS - After admin change, coach reloading /suggestions sees the Planned badge on the affected suggestion. Additionally a prior suggestion shows the admin_note ('Admin: Good idea, on the roadmap') back on the coach's own list, confirming admin_note propagation.

critical_code_review_comments: Suggestions.jsx: on submit error, admin's all-list is not refreshed via loadAll on failure path - minor.
STATUS_META label 'declined' displays 'Not planned' (intentional but non-obvious to admin selecting from dropdown); consider consistency in labels.
test_credentials: Admin admin@attendance.app / Admin@12345; Coach coach.test@example.com / Coach@12345 (both via toggle-admin-login).
seed_data_creation: Created a live coach suggestion during test run; also existed a prior 'Please remember the last fleet I used in Muster' suggestion with admin_note 'Good idea, on the roadmap' -> both now marked 'planned'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature works end-to-end on preview. Data-testids used: suggestions-page, suggestion-form, suggestion-text, suggestion-category, suggestion-submit, suggestion-tabs, suggestion-tab-mine, suggestion-tab-all, suggestion-mine, suggestion-all, suggestion-mine-<id>, suggestion-all-<id>, suggestion-status-<status>, suggestion-status-select-<id>.
